title: A 30-second scroll break: calm breathing to do before you keep scrolling.

copy.instagram_caption:
Phone got your heart rate up? Here's a 30-second reset to come back down.

In through your nose for 4. Out slowly for 6. Three rounds. The long exhale does the work.

A new scroll break every week. Save this one for the next time the feed has you wired.

DeRot pauses your apps while you reset with a few calming breaths. Coming soon to iPhone. Launch list: link in bio.
